verses.1: The sons of Judah were Perez, Chezron, Karmi, Huru, and Shovall.
verses.2: And Reuah ben Shoval had Yahat as his son. Yahat, in turn, had Ahumai and Lahad as his sons. These were the descendants of the Zeraiti family.
verses.3: And these are the fathers of their tribes: Yizrael, Ishmael, and Edbash. The name of their sister tribe is Zelphoniy.
verses.4: And Penuel, my father Gidor, and Ezer, my father Hushah, these are the sons of Hur. They lived in the land of Ephratah, my father’s house.
verses.5: And in Ashhur, my father’s wife, there were two women: one was old, and the other was young.
verses.6: And she gave birth to a son for him: Nahash, Hagar, Tahmani, and Ahashtar. These were the sons of Nahash.
verses.7: And the sons of Hilaah were Zerach and Tzohar.
verses.8: And Kokesh will give birth to Anub and Tzovva, along with other children. And Aharhel, son of Rohum, will also be born.
verses.9: And Ya’ebet was taken captive by his brothers. His mother called out his name, Ya’ebet, saying, “I gave birth to him in sorrow.”
verses.10: And Yaveh called out to the God of Israel, saying, “If you bless me and increase my territory, and if your hand is with me, and if you do not do me any harm, then I will be happy. But if you do harm to me, then I will be sorrowful.” And God brought upon him what he had asked for.
verses.11: And the little puppy that is born from its wombs is its own father.
verses.12: And his wife gave birth to Rephael, Pashchah, and Techana. Abi was the king of the city of Nahash. These were the people of Rekhah.
verses.13: And the sons of Kenaz were Atniyal and Sheriyah. And the sons of Atniyal were Hattat.
verses.14: And Mewonotai gave birth to Afra, and Shriyah gave birth to Yoav. My father was Geya Harashim, because they were indeed harashim.
verses.15: And the sons of Klab, son of Yefunah, were Elah and Vanaam. And the sons of Elah and Kanz.
verses.16: And the sons of Jehielel: Ziph and Ziphah Tiyria and Asharael.
verses.17: And Ben-Ezra, along with Merod and Efer, also joined forces. They attacked Maryam, Shamay, and Yishvach. My father was defeated.
verses.18: And his Jewish wife gave birth to Yered Avi Gdor, and to Chavir Avi Shokho. She also gave birth to Yekutiel Avi Zanocha. These are the sons of Bathya, the daughter of Pharaoh, who was taken away by Marad.
verses.19: And the sons of Hodiyah were Naham, my father K’ilah the Garimi, and Eshtemoya the Ma’akhati.
verses.20: And the sons of Shimon Amnon, and Rina, son of Hanan; and Tilo, and the sons of Ishai Zohath, and Zohath’s son.
verses.21: The sons of Shela, sons of Judah: Eir Avi Lekha and Adah Avi Marasha. And from the families of the servants of the Lord, came Ashbe’a.
verses.22: And those who are wicked and deceitful, and those who are cruel and violent. They who lead others astray. And I will dwell in hunger, and the words of the past will remain unspoken.
verses.23: All those creators, as well as those who work in gardens and orchards, will sit with the king while he carries out his tasks.
verses.24: The sons of Shimeon were Nemuel and Yamin. Yariv Zerach Shaul also had children.
verses.25: He was born from his mother’s womb; he was born from his father’s womb.
verses.26: And the sons of Mishmael were Hamuel, Zachur, and Shimei.
verses.27: And their sons numbered sixteen. Their daughters were six. And they had no many sons. All of their families did not number as many as the descendants of Judah.
verses.28: And they settled in Be’er Sheva, Moldavia, and Chasur Shual.
verses.29: And in the morning, and at noon, and in the evening.
verses.30: And in Bithuel, and in Charmah, and in Tiklag.
verses.31: And in the stables, and in the courtyards, there were horses. And in the houses of Beria and in their gates, these were their cities, all of them, until King David’s time.
verses.32: And their palaces were filled with snakes, vipers, scorpions, and smoke from burning cities.
verses.33: And all their houses, which are located around these cities, will also be destroyed. They will be left in ruins and become nothing more than ruins.
verses.34: And Rehoboam became king and ruled over Israel.
verses.35: And Yeoval, and Yehuah, son of Joshibiyah, son of Serayah, son of Ashiyal.
verses.36: And Eloyeyna, Yaakovah, Yishoachia, Asya, Adiyel, Yishimiel, and Benaya.
verses.37: And Zizia ben-Shifai, ben-Alon, ben-Yedaya, ben-Shimri, ben-Shma’ya.
verses.38: These are those who come in the names of their leaders, from their families and homes. They rushed forth into the battle.
verses.39: And they went to Meboua Gdor, until they reached the eastern side of the Gaya. There, they sought refuge from the rain.
verses.40: And they found salt and good soil. The land was wide enough to cover their hands, and it was peaceful and calm. It was a place where those who lived there could live in peace.
verses.41: And these writings were brought forth in their names during the time of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah. They destroyed their altars and the places where they kept their offerings. They remained sealed up until today. They lie buried there, as if they were a burden to those who find them there.
verses.42: And from among the sons of Shimeon, went to Mount Seir these people: five hundred men, along with Paltiya, Ne’ayah, Rafaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Isai.
verses.43: And they conquered the rest of the land and brought it under Babylonian rule. They settled there until today.
